name: sdet-pipeline
description: Playwright + TypeScript SDET pipeline: UI/API/visual test-authoring, execution, bug-reporting, and code-review sub agents driven by one spec-aware command (/sdet: spec discovery, traceable test cases, idempotent automation, config-selected UI/API/visual layers, config-gated security/accessibility), with guardrail hooks (secret-leak blocking, .env-commit blocking, execution-log enforcement) and a persistent per-run execution log.
